# Desktop shell – conformance matrix (generated by the shell's tools/matrix.py)

Every clickable element of the boards this deliverable covers, from `docs/ui/CLICKS.md`, with the
status of its action in `design/conformance/coverage.toml` (ok / different / missing), the code that
implements it and the test that proves it. *Owner* names elements of other programs on the same board.
Side-by-side renders (board | implementation, and the implementation in ar/en × dark/light) are
listed in desktop-shell.md.

## DesktopTop

Built as a variant (`desktop.bar_position = top`, `--bar top`); the bottom bar stays the standard. Not as the board: the status icons say what the services report (no Wi-Fi/sound/battery service: the offline icon), the dock's shadow is cut at the top of its panel, the drive tile is missing (no volume service).

## Overview

The windows are the compositor's copies (WindowThumbnail), the strip shows the compositor's workspaces (SwitchWorkspace), the close button lies inside the card's top end corner (toolkit overlay, round 3).

## CompactHome

Built at phone size (compact screens or `ULTAR_OBERFLAECHE=handy`); the compositor runs in phone mode (windows without title bars over the work area, edge gestures for the shell). The Hijri date is computed (the board's is illustrative).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | الإعدادات السريعة | `mobile.status` | ok | platform/ultar-desktop/src/view/compact/quick.rs + src/shell/bar.rs | platform/ultar-desktop/tests/phone.rs – tap or swipe down opens; handle (tap, swipe up), dimmed part, Esc, home close |
